# A security whose smallest unit is a sixteenth of a share, holding 3/16 of one.
#
# What this fixture produces: CAD; OLDCO in the namespace NYSE with a fraction of
# 16; Assets and Assets:Broker Cash in CAD and Assets:OLDCO in OLDCO; and one
# transaction buying 0.1875 of a share, which is 3/16, for 7.50 CAD. A sixteenth
# is not a tenth or a hundredth, so the quantity has no decimal form at the
# commodity's own unit and is written as the exact decimal it is.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_security_traded_in_sixteenths_keeps_its_quantity.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity OLDCO
	mnemonic: "OLDCO"
	fullname: "Old Company"
	namespace: "NYSE"
	fraction: 16
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Broker Cash
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:OLDCO
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NYSE"
	commodity.mnemonic: "OLDCO"

2026-02-02 * "Buy 3/16 of a share of OLDCO"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:OLDCO 0.1875 OLDCO
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "OLDCO"
		share_price: "40"
		value: "7.50"
	Assets:Broker Cash -7.50 CAD
